rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the palm of the hand.

example.english: A mosquito bit my palm, and it's really itchy.
example.traditional: 我隻手掌畀蚊針到，好痕。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 zoeng2 bei2 man1 zam1 dou2 hou2 han4

rows.note: Use this for the tropical tree rather than the palm of the hand.

example.english: There are lots of palm trees in the park.
example.traditional: 公園入面有好多棕櫚樹。
example.jyutping: gung1 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 zung1 leoi4 syu6
